reason: This function matches discounts to dispatches by comparing dispatch.lineItems[].id against discount.lineItemId. For return trips, mapOrderDispatchesToMozioDispatches appends '#return' to the line item ID via getDispatchLineItemKey, but getUniqDiscounts uses the raw lineItem.id without the suffix. The filter on line 16-18 therefore never matches return-trip dispatches, so the promo discount amount is never applied to the return leg's report.price.discount.
